recent_facts: The feral overseer was completely deleted by the System following the 14,800 environmental damage blow.
The local frontier node lost its anchor and began a catastrophic structural collapse.
Rhea looted the Overseer's Sanctum Desk, securing the Mythic-tier Mercy Cache Coordinates and the High-Tier Administrative Residue Token.
The System initiated a 30-second Frontier Zone Purge, broadcasting a critical failure across the zone.

last_scene: The feral overseer dissolved into code as the local node destabilized and the Inner Office began to collapse.
Rhea, suffering from zero stamina, dragged herself to the administrative extraction point at the overturned desk.
She successfully looted the Mercy Cache Coordinates and the Administrative Residue Token, stowing them in her blazer pocket.
Unit 734 projected a 30-second purge timer as the System broadcast a critical failure, forcing the party to prepare for an immediate escape.
